title: Amount Kept on the TRICARE Prime Fee Account from a Duplicate Payment
content:
**Clause.** On the refund of a duplicate payment on a TRICARE Prime installment other than the first installment: where the enrollment pays through an allotment and the account shows payments collected through it, the region keeps two regular installments of the excess on the account; where it pays through a recurring card or electronic funds transfer and the account shows payments collected through that method, the region keeps one regular installment on the account; otherwise it keeps nothing. What the region keeps on the account is not refunded.

## Judgement table

| Enrollment's payment method | The account shows payments collected through that method | Kept on the account |
|---|---|---|
| allotment | yes | 2 regular installments |
| allotment | no | nothing |
| recurring card or electronic funds transfer | yes | 1 regular installment |
| recurring card or electronic funds transfer | no | nothing |
| single card payment or check | - | nothing |

## Hypothetical case

An allotment-paying enrollment whose account shows allotment payments, with a regular installment of 32.51, keeps 65.02 of the excess on the account.
